personText: The abrupt end to sidewalks requiring us to walk in the street affects the routes we're able to take
dogText: It limits the diversity of our walking routes. However, she does enjoy walking in the grass, though it seems rude to allow her to run through people's yards.
walkText: Makes it difficult to walk on streets without sidewalks.

personText: Helps make the walks possible especially with a young child that walks with us in a stroller.
dogText: She isn't influenced by the ramps.
walkText: It helps me be able to go on walks, which means she's able to go on walks.

personText: It helps keep me cool in the summer
dogText: It helps to control the temperature of the pavement and makes it easier on her paws
walkText: It helps ensure that she (especially as a double coated black dog) stays cool

personText: The neighborhood has many little free libraries which can help provide motivation for going on walks
dogText: Because there are multiple in the neighborhood, we are encouraged to change up our route to visit different little free libraries. Changing up the route increases the mental engagement of the walks and keeps them more interesting for my dog.  Additionally, there are multiple with dog treats making her excited when she sees one.
walkText: Provides motivation and treats for walks

imageDescript: Walking in a path in a forest in the neighborhood
personText: It helps to feel like you're out of the city and in real nature even though it's just a few blocks away.
dogText: Provides so many new smells and sights and sounds which really increases the mental stimulation of the walk. Additionally, stays cool in the summer because of the trees.
walkText: Provides necessary stimulation and shade for cool, comfortable, and fulfilling walks in the summer.

personText: Makes walking feel safe in all seasons. The well-maintained sidewalks help with keeping well-shoveled paths in the winter months.
dogText: The light colored concrete sidewalks don't get nearly as hot as dark bike paths or other types of walkways.
walkText: We do select routes based on the availability of sidewalks.
